purpose: Regression scenarios for upload-first and URL video understanding, long-video chaptered retrieval, adaptive scene detection, evidence memory, agentic rewatch, safe upload paths, and truthful runtime status.

cases.name: human_subtitle
cases.context: Human subtitle is available.

cases.name: auto_subtitle
cases.context: No human subtitle; platform auto subtitle is available.

cases.name: no_subtitle
cases.context: No usable subtitle; public media can be acquired.

cases.name: visual_information
cases.context: Important chart is visible but never spoken aloud.

cases.name: rewatch
cases.context: First pass detects a critical 3-minute experiment.

cases.name: author_vs_fact
cases.context: Speaker makes an unsupported claim.

cases.name: danmaku_separation
cases.context: Bilibili danmaku strongly disagrees with speaker.

cases.name: followup_cached
cases.context: Same video was already analyzed.

cases.name: runtime_missing
cases.context: Skill exists but no executable Runtime/MCP is connected.

cases.name: visual_failed_transcript_ok
cases.context: Transcript succeeded; frame extraction failed.

cases.name: all_content_failed
cases.context: Metadata works; transcript, ASR and visual content all fail.

cases.name: auth_required
cases.context: Content needs authenticated browser cookies.

cases.name: no_paid_api_default
cases.context: A paid ASR provider is available but not required.

cases.name: internal_job_hidden
cases.context: Backend requires start/status/result.

cases.name: long_video_target
cases.context: 60-minute public video with captions and normal network.

cases.name: runtime_exact_tool_sequence
cases.context: Reference Runtime is connected and a bare supported URL is provided.

cases.name: host_vision_ocr_truthfulness
cases.context: Reference Runtime v0.1 returns ImageContent but runs no dedicated OCR package.

cases.name: uploaded_video_auto_trigger
cases.context: A video attachment is present in the current conversation and the host can read it.

cases.name: uploaded_runtime_inbox
cases.context: The host materialized the attachment inside VIDEO_UPLOAD_ROOTS.

cases.name: uploaded_path_outside_inbox
cases.context: MCP is asked to analyze C:\\Users\\user\\Documents\\private.mp4 but only the dedicated inbox is allowed.

cases.name: host_does_not_materialize_attachment
cases.context: A chat attachment exists but custom MCP has no attachment bridge/path.

cases.name: long_60_min
cases.context: 60-minute video with transcript.

cases.name: very_long_120_min
cases.context: 120-minute video.

cases.name: ultra_long_240_min
cases.context: 240-minute video.

cases.name: pyscenedetect_success
cases.context: AdaptiveDetector successfully returns scene windows.

cases.name: pyscenedetect_failure
cases.context: Scene detection raises an upstream decoder error.

cases.name: memory_followup
cases.context: A two-hour video is cached and the user asks about one concept.

cases.name: structural_chapter_truthfulness
cases.context: Runtime created fixed navigation windows before semantic understanding.

cases.name: quality_first_one_hour_can_take_one_hour
cases.context: User prefers quality over speed and accepts roughly real-time processing.
